notes.subject: fix(desktop): bring the Assistant forward when its notification is clicked
notes.summary: Clicking an Assistant notification in the desktop app now reveals the window and switches to the Assistant view; older desktop builds without the bridge method are unaffected.

notes.subject: feat(agent): search and read earlier sessions in the same workspace
notes.summary: The VS Code agent can now search and read earlier sessions in the same project through new tools backed by a local index, and the shared service ships as @agentlink/core/workspace-session-history. Continue prompts now wrap commands in backticks.
